​‍‍​​‍​‍​‍‍‍‍​​‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​​​‍​​​‍​​​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​​​​​‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍‍‍‍​​​​‍‍​‍​​​​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍‍‍‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍‍‍​‍‍​​‍‍​​​‍​​‍‍​‍‍‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍‍​​​‍‍​​​‍​​‍‍​‍‍‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍​​​‍​‍‍​​​‍‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍‍​​‍​​​‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍‍​​​‍‍​​​‍‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍‍​​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍​​​​​‍​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​‍‍‍‍​​​​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​‍‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​​​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍​‍​​​‍‍​‍‍​​​‍​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍‍‍‍​​​​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​​​​​‍​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​​​‍​​​​‍​​‍‍‍‍​​‍​‍‍​​​‍​​​‍‍​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​​‍‍​​‍​​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍​​​​‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍‍​​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​‍​​‍‍​​​​​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​​​‍​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​‍​​‍​​‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍‍​‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍​​​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍‍‍​​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍‍​‍​​​​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​​‍‍​​​​​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​‍​​‍​​‍‍​​​​​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍‍‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​​‍​​‍‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​​​‍​​‍‍‍‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​‍​‍​‍‍‍‍​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍‍​​​‍‍​​​‍‍​​‍‍​​‍​​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍‍‍‍​​‍​‍‍​​‍​​​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​‍‍​​‍​​​‍‍‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍‍‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​​​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍​‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍​​​‍​‍​​‍‍​​‍​​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​‍​​​‍​‍‍‍‍​‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​​‍‍​​‍‍​​​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍​‍‍‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍‍‍​‍‍‍​‍​​‍‍‍‍​‍​‍​‍​​​‍​‍​‍‍​​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍‍‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍‍​​​‍‍​‍‍‍‍​‍​​‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​​‍​​​‍‍​‍​‍‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍​​​‍​​​​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​​‍​​​‍​​​‍‍​​​‍​​​‍‍​​‍​​​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​​​​​‍​‍‍​‍​​‍​‍​‍‍‍​​‍‍​‍​‍​​‍‍​​​​​‍​‍​‍​‍​‍​​‍​​​​‍​​‍​‍​​‍‍‍​‍‍​​‍‍​​​‍‍​‍​​​‍‍‍ - IDA反汇编分析结果 (capstone)
=====================================
文件: bypwn (6368 bytes, 64-bit ELF, stripped)

=== 安全保护 ===
RELRO:      Partial RELRO
Stack Canary: NO
NX:         DISABLED (GNU_STACK flags=XWR, stack is executable)
PIE:        NO (fixed addresses)

=== 关键函数 ===

--- setbuf_wrapper (0x4007b6) ---
  设置 stdout/stdin/stderr 为无缓冲
  setbuf(stdout, 0)
  setbuf(stdin, 0)
  setbuf(stderr, 0)

--- get_input (0x4007f9) ---
  栈帧: sub rsp, 0x20 (32字节局部变量)
  
  1. memset(rbp-0x20, 0, 0x20)       清零缓冲区
  2. puts("well you input:")          提示
  3. read(0, rbp-0x20, 0x20)          读取32字节 [LEAK点]
  4. strdup(rbp-0x20)                 复制到堆 [VULN: 无null则读取栈上数据]
  5. [rbp-8] = strdup返回值           保存堆指针
  6. printf("check it, %s\n", [rbp-8])  打印内容 [LEAK输出]
  7. return [rbp-8]                   返回堆指针

--- main (0x400863) ---
  栈帧: sub rsp, 0x50 (80字节局部变量)
  
  1. call setbuf_wrapper              初始化
  2. call get_input                   获取输入 -> [rbp-8] = 返回值
  3. puts("EASY PWN PWN PWN~")        提示
  4. scanf("%s", rbp-0x50)            读取输入 [OVERFLOW点]
  5. puts("bye~")                     提示
  6. leave; ret                       返回

=== 栈布局 (main函数) ===
  rbp-0x50: scanf缓冲区 (80字节)
  rbp+0x00: saved rbp (8字节)
  rbp+0x08: return address (8字节) <- 溢出目标
  
  溢出偏移: 0x50 + 8 = 88字节

=== 泄露机制 (get_input) ===
  栈布局 (get_input函数):
    rbp-0x20: read缓冲区 (32字节)
    rbp+0x00: saved rbp (= main的rbp, 栈地址)
    rbp+0x08: return address (0x40087f)
  
  read()读取32字节，如果不含null:
    strdup()会读取到32字节之后的saved rbp
    printf("%s")会打印出来 -> 泄露栈地址
  
  泄露数据: [32字节输入][6-8字节saved rbp][3字节ret addr]
  saved rbp是main的rbp，可计算scanf缓冲区地址

=== ROP Gadgets ===
  0x400611: ret                        (clean)
  0x400715: jmp rax                    (clean)
  0x4008b2: leave; ret                 (clean)
  0x4008b3: ret                        (clean)
  0x400923: pop rdi; ret               (BAD: 0x09 in addr)
  0x4009a3: call rsp                   (BAD: 0x09 in addr)
  
  scanf("%s")坏字节: 0x09 0x0a 0x0b 0x0c 0x0d 0x20
  → 0x4009xx地址均含0x09，不能用于scanf溢出payload
  → 无法使用ret2libc（需要pop rdi设置参数）
  → 改用Ret2Shellcode：泄露栈地址后直接跳转

=== PLT/GOT ===
  puts@plt    = 0x400630    puts@got    = 0x601018
  setbuf@plt  = 0x400640    setbuf@got  = 0x601020
  printf@plt  = 0x400650    printf@got  = 0x601028
  memset@plt  = 0x400660    memset@got  = 0x601030
  read@plt    = 0x400670    read@got    = 0x601038
  scanf@plt   = 0x400690    scanf@got   = 0x601048
  strdup@plt  = 0x4006a0    strdup@got  = 0x601050

  0x400954: "check it, %s\n"
  0x400962: "EASY PWN PWN PWN~"
  0x400974: "%s"
  0x400977: "bye~"
